## Exact admission strength and function-graph completion

7 October 2026. [The admission study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ROOT-MATHEMATICAL-ADMISSION-INTEGRATION.md) integrates the affirmative argument, substantive counterreview and focused primary-source assessment. The new [formal package](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/constitution/admission/README.md) records **52 checked Lean theorems and 86 declaration audits**.

For a supplied carrier and predicate admission condition, full admission is equivalent to admitting all finite predicates and closing under **every ambient nonempty directed union**. With finite admission fixed, this closure is exactly the remaining strength. The family of all finite parts of an arbitrary target predicate witnesses the implication. Its selection already refers to that target; the result does not independently justify the range of whole families.

The finite/cofinite comparison satisfies finite admission, complement and binary union, matches every finite membership pattern and is invariant under arbitrary supplied bijections. It nevertheless excludes the even predicate on the natural numbers and fails directed closure. These weaker conditions do not force full admission. This comparison is neither a model of full comprehension nor a rival preserving the whole full-predicate target. A matched full-target structural account may accept the same domains and truths while disputing their ultimate dependence; it also owes an admission warrant.

A second result closes the previous representation gap at function types. Total functional ideals of finite relations correspond inversely to full functions. Functionality is characterized through finite members; totality still requires a value for every input. Applying this construction recursively gives predicate and arrow types a common ideal framework and preserves every formula of the earlier declared finite simple-type language. Classical decoding, all qualifying ideals and global totality remain explicit. Admission of all Boolean-function true fibers is equivalent to fullness for the same predicate condition; no independent function-family closure premise is silently inferred.

**Current boundary:** complete representation of admitted content does not itself establish admission of every complete profile. The full-admission principle and its constitutive root dependence still need independent justification. Repeating maximality, absence of privileged exclusion or another equivalent encoding does not supply it. The next universal result must justify the whole-family range and its completions, or establish the claimed explanatory reduction against a matched full-target account. This stops the repeated argument without asserting that such a justification is impossible.
